git_scope: Blobless clone, sparse checkout of the named files at the pinned commit, the parent of issue #607's pin 43ac7d2 and the commit after b85dee2, the pin of #586. Against b85dee2 it adds 290 certificates (370 and 403 to 991), changes seven (211, 339, 378, 379, 380, 381 and 382), deletes 22 and rewrites the author's index upper_bounds.json. The one certificate inside the case corpus, certificates/n211.cert, is retained as factual data. The 296 certificates beyond n = 324, 33 MB, are bulk data under OR-18 and pinned by digest only, with their metadata; their exact header sides are compared in review/. The READMEs, the index, and n211's decimal packing and drawing are pinned by digest only. The rest of the tree, including the unchanged certificates, the search programs and the lower-bound files, is pinned by the commit and was not retained or executed.
